details.title: Session Messages
details.storageTip: No detailed data found. Possible reasons: Redis is disabled/unavailable (REDIS_URL + ENABLE_RATE_LIMIT=true), the data expired (SESSION_TTL, default 300s), or response body storage is disabled (STORE_SESSION_RESPONSE_BODY=false, affects response body only). To store unredacted messages, set STORE_SESSION_MESSAGES=true.
